subject: storytime
title: Forever Friends words
about: Drag is a dreamy dragon and Rex is a tidy T. rex, and in three short stories the two best friends pick a breakfast, bundle up for a snowy day and face something scary together. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: After the level, borrow the book from the library and read one of the three stories together each night.

book.author: Susan Lubner
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: The first Drag and Rex book: a dragon and a T. rex who are best friends, in three easy chapters.

passage.text:
Drag Rex dragon forever
tail wings breakfast toast
zipper button coat boots
scarf snow sled scared
brave friends

cards.note: capital D, it is a name, short for dragon; d-r blend
capital R, it is a name; x says ks
two parts: drag + on; the o says u: drag-un
three parts: for-ev-er; or says or and er says er
ng is one sound; the s says z
two parts: break + fast; ea says e here, like in bread: brek-fast
oa says long o; s-t at the end
pp is one p; two parts: zip + per; er says er
tt is one t; two parts: but + ton, the o says u: but-un
oo says long oo; the s says s
s-n blend; ow says long o
s-c blend; are says air, like in care: skaird
b-r blend; magic e makes a say its name
ie says e; the s says z: frendz
